description: MainActivity.kt is the primary source file for an Android Kotlin application implementing a Tic-Tac-Toe game. It contains the main activity class managing the game state, user interface interactions, game logic, and AI move handling.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages user interactions, game state, and UI updates for the Tic-Tac-Toe game. It includes game logic, AI move scheduling, and persistent user settings.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, loads saved preferences, and resets the game to start state.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game board, UI, and game state for a new game, respecting current settings.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles user tapping a cell, applies move, and triggers AI turn if necessary.

methods.name: applyMove
methods.description: Places a move on the board, updates UI, and checks for game end conditions.

methods.name: findWinner
methods.description: Checks the board for a winner after each move.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Determines if the game is a draw (full board, no winner).

methods.name: updatePlayerIndicator
methods.description: Updates the UI to indicate the current player's turn.

methods.name: applyMarkStyling
methods.description: Styles a cell after a move is made.

methods.name: other
methods.description: Returns the opposite player's symbol ('X' or 'O').
